description: This file defines the 'Handling' class in the Opencart ormat ramework, which extends a system engine model and provides functionality to calculate and add handling fees and taxes to the total amount in an OpenCart extension module.

classes.name: Handling
classes.description: Represents the handling fee extension in the OpenCart system, responsible for adding handling Fees and related tax calculations to the order total.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the handling fee to the totals array if the cart subtotal exceeds a configured threshold, and manages tax calculations for the fee.
